title: Wasalt company profile
text: Wasalt (وصلت) is a Saudi digital real-estate platform (website and app) for buying, selling and renting residential and commercial property. Wasalt is a joint venture between two leading Saudi real-estate companies: Dar Al Arkan and Quara Holding. Dar Al Arkan is also the parent of DarGlobal, so Wasalt and DarGlobal are sister companies. Wasalt is licensed by REGA (General Real Estate Authority) as a real-estate portal, and licensed by Infath (Entrustment and Liquidation Center) to run electronic and hybrid real-estate auctions. Services: property search, Wasalt Matchmaker (connects users with agents), Wasalt Projects (new residential developments), Wasalt Masterplans, Wasalt Auctions, daily rentals, and Wasalt Business, a CRM app for brokers to manage listings, leads and teams. Listings are verified with transparent pricing.

title: DarGlobal company profile
text: DarGlobal (Dar Global PLC) is a London Stock Exchange-listed (ticker DAR) luxury real-estate developer, investor and asset manager, and the international arm of Saudi developer Dar Al Arkan. It develops branded residences with partners including The Trump Organization, Missoni, Pagani, Elie Saab, Fendi Casa and W Hotels, in Saudi Arabia (Riyadh, Jeddah, Diriyah/Wadi Safar), the UAE (Dubai), Qatar (Lusail/Doha), Oman (Muscat/AIDA) and Spain (Costa del Sol, e.g. Tierra Viva; Marea by Missoni at Cortesin). Its project portfolio GDV reached about US$23bn by mid-2026 (US$19bn at end-2025, US$7.5bn at end-2024). Sister company: Wasalt, the Saudi property portal (Dar Al Arkan / Quara Holding joint venture).
